units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 1:1">Kel. I, 1</cite> <he>מטמאין במ׳</he> make the carrier unclean.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 1:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>ששוה מַגָּעוֹ למַשָּׂאוֹ</he> the touch of which has the same effect as the carrying of it; a. fr.

senses.gloss: מ׳ ומַתָּן carrying and giving, business, dealings; worldly affairs; intercourse.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 120a">Sabb. 120ᵃ</cite> <he>במ׳ ומ׳</he> in worldly affairs, opp. <he>בדברי תורה</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 35a:10">Kidd. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>איש דבר מ׳ ומ׳</he> a man (has the protection of the law) because he is engaged in business.
<cite ref="Yoma 86a:13">Yoma 86ᵃ</cite> <he>מַשָּׂאוֹ ומַתָּנוֹ וכ׳</he> his dealings with men; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 30b:5">Kidd. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>כל משאו ומתנו בך</he> he (the tempter) will always be busy with thee.

Gen. R. s. 44 עשרה לשונות נקראת נבואה … מ׳ וכ׳ prophecy goes by ten names: ‘vision’ … ‘burden’ &c.; ib. רבנן אמרי מ׳ כמשמעו וכ׳ the Rabbis say, the severest of all is massa, as its name indicates (burden) &c.; Cant. R. to III, 4; a. e.—Pl. מַשָּׂאוֹת.
